release_notes: Output & Export now groups Picking List, Packing List, Line-based AWB, and Batch Issue Report actions into four clear columns.
Batch Issue Report PDF summarizes parser/system issues, SKU naming issues, operator timing, and mitigations for daily postmortems.
DSApp review is split into Alias, Quantity, and Variant workbenches for focused reconciliation.
Mapping dialogs now support uninterrupted autocomplete, blank remap searches, and Create New SKU fallback.
Manual signature boxes now print at the bottom-right of every PDF page.
